run_train_vqgan: run the VQGAN training script with configurable dataset, optimizer, and discriminator settings
create_vqgan_model: create a VQModel with configurable encoder-decoder blocks, embedding dimensions, and number of codebook entries
test_validation_reconstruction: test VQGAN reconstruction quality by generating images from validation set and logging to tensorboard or wandb
refactor_perceptual_loss: refactor perceptual loss computation using a pretrained timm backbone for feature-space MSE comparison
review_gradient_penalty: review the gradient penalty computation for WGAN-GP style discriminator training regularization
